logp.method_description: The octanol/water partition coefficient of 99m TcN-2was measured following 1 min vigorous vortex mixing of 2 mL of octanol, 1.9 mL of phosphate buffer (0.05 mol/ L, pH ¼ 7:0), and 100 mL of test solution in a centrifuge tube. The sample was centrifuged at 4000 rpm for 5 min and the counts in 100 mL aliquots of both organic and inorganic layers were determined using a NaI welltype g-counter. The partition coefficient (P) was calculated using the following equation: P ¼ ðcpm in octanolcpm background)/(cpm in water  cpm background). The reported octanol/water partition coefficient represents the mean of three measurements.
